medical_disclaimer.title: Before you start
medical_disclaimer.intro: Happy Women helps you track your cycle, symptoms and pregnancy. It is not a medical device and does not give medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
medical_disclaimer.predictions: Period, fertile-window and ovulation predictions are estimates. Never use them as contraception.
medical_disclaimer.dating: Due dates and pregnancy weeks are estimated from your last period. Your clinician may adjust them after an ultrasound.
medical_disclaimer.care: Talk to a qualified health professional about any symptoms or concerns. In an emergency, or if your baby is moving less than usual, get medical care right away.

cycle_guide.title: How you may feel
cycle_guide.disclaimer: Everyone is different. These are common patterns, not rules. If mood changes feel severe or stop you from living normally, talk to a doctor.
cycle_guide.source: Based on NHS and ACOG patient guidance.

menstrual.hormones: Oestrogen and progesterone are at their lowest, which starts the bleed.
menstrual.mood: Tiredness, low mood or wanting quiet time is common, especially on the first two days. Many people feel relief once bleeding starts.
menstrual.energy: Low. Cramps and blood loss can be draining.
menstrual.self_care: Warmth on your tummy, rest, gentle walks, iron-rich food and plenty of water.
menstrual.partner: Take over a chore, bring a warm drink or her favourite chocolate, and offer a heating pad. Ask what she needs instead of guessing.

follicular.hormones: Oestrogen rises steadily as an egg matures.
follicular.mood: Often brighter, more optimistic and more social. Many people feel most like themselves.
follicular.energy: Rising. A good time for new plans and harder workouts.
follicular.self_care: Try something new, plan ahead and enjoy the extra energy.
follicular.partner: Plan a date or something fun together. Encourage her ideas and plans.

ovulation.hormones: Oestrogen peaks and a surge of LH releases the egg.
ovulation.mood: Confident, outgoing and affectionate. Some people feel a brief dip or mild one-sided pain.
ovulation.energy: At its highest for most people.
ovulation.self_care: Social plans, exercise and time outdoors suit this phase well.
ovulation.partner: Compliment her, spend quality time together and be affectionate.

luteal.hormones: Progesterone rises, then both hormones fall in the last week before the period.
luteal.mood: Calm at first. In the last week, irritability, sadness, anxiety or feeling overwhelmed (PMS) are common.
luteal.energy: Slowly falling. Cravings and bloating are normal.
luteal.self_care: Regular meals, less caffeine and salt, magnesium-rich foods, gentle exercise and early nights.
luteal.partner: Be patient and kind. Send a positive message, bring flowers or a comfort snack, and don't take short tempers personally.

pregnancy.1: Weeks 1–13: rising hormones can bring nausea, tiredness and mood swings. Rest and small, frequent meals help.
pregnancy.2: Weeks 14–27: energy often returns and mood steadies. A good time for gentle exercise and planning.
pregnancy.3: Weeks 28–40: discomfort, poor sleep and worry about birth are common. Support, rest and preparation help.

focus.menstrual: Period: iron and vitamin C to replace what you lose, omega-3 for cramps.
focus.follicular: Follicular: protein, fibre and folate to match your rising energy.
focus.ovulation: Ovulation: fibre and antioxidants (vitamin C, omega-3).
focus.luteal: Luteal: magnesium, vitamin B6 and slow carbs to ease PMS and cravings.
focus.t1: Trimester 1: folate for baby's development, small meals for nausea.
focus.t2: Trimester 2: iron, calcium and protein as baby grows fast.
focus.t3: Trimester 3: fibre, omega-3, calcium and protein for the final stretch.

onboarding.paired_body: We'll help you understand her cycle, notice how she might be feeling, and show up in small, kind ways.
onboarding.goals_title: What would you like Happy Women to help with?
onboarding.goals_body: Pick as many as you like.
onboarding.goal_learn_science: Learn how her cycle and symptoms work
onboarding.goal_support_partner: Understand her so I can support her
onboarding.goal_communication: Talk to each other more easily
onboarding.goal_anticipate: Know how she might be feeling
onboarding.goal_sex_life: Feel closer, and improve our intimacy
onboarding.paired_privacy: She decides what you see, and can unlink anytime
onboarding.symptoms_title: Does {{name}} usually get any of these?
onboarding.symptoms_body: Your best guess is fine. It helps us pick tips.
onboarding.symptoms_note: Only you see this. Her own logs stay private to her.
onboarding.fertile_title: Did you know some days she's more likely to get pregnant?
onboarding.fertile_reply_yes: Nice! Here's how we show it.
onboarding.fertile_reply_no: Most people don't. Here's the short version.
onboarding.fertile_body: Her fertile window is about 6 days around ovulation. If she chooses to share it, you'll see it here, whether you're hoping for a baby or not.
onboarding.intimacy_title: Anything you'd both like to grow in your intimate life?
onboarding.intimacy_body: Totally optional, and private to you.
onboarding.intimacy_timing: Know the best timing for us
onboarding.setup_title: Thanks, {{name}}! Getting things ready for you both
onboarding.setup_title_anonymous: Thanks! Getting things ready for you both

invite.title: Share with your partner
invite.body: Your partner gets a heads-up before your period, a guide to how you may feel, and small ideas to support you. They never see your symptoms, moods or notes.
invite.message: I use Happy Women to track my cycle. Join me so you know how I'm doing: {{url}} (or enter code {{code}} in the app).
invite.share_failed: Couldn't open that app. Try another way to share.
invite.share_body: Send this code or link to your partner. They install Happy Women and enter it to pair with you.
invite.lost_code: Lost the code? Create a new one
invite.cancel_confirm: This code will stop working straight away.
invite.pull_to_refresh: Waiting for your partner to join. Pull down to refresh.
invite.tap_to_copy: Tap the code to copy the link
invite.copy_shared: Choose "Copy" in the menu to copy your link.

linked.title: Linked with {{name}}
linked.unlink_confirm: Your partner will stop seeing your updates straight away.
linked.sees: They can see: period dates, cycle phase and, if you allow, your fertile window or pregnancy due date.

join.title: Join your partner
join.body: Paste the link she sent you, or type her code.

join.no_code: There is no partner code in that text. Paste the link she sent, or type the code (HW-XXXX-XXXX).
join.choose_title: I received a link or code
join.how_1: She makes a code in her Partner tab and sends it to you.
join.how_2: You enter it here. Each code works once.
join.how_3: You see her phase and dates. She can unlink anytime.

home.not_linked_body: Ask her to create an invite in Happy Women, then enter the code.

ttc.title: Trying to conceive
ttc.relax: Keep it relaxed: a slow evening, a back or shoulder massage, and no pressure. Stress doesn't help either of you.
ttc.doctor: These are estimates. If you've been trying for 12 months (6 months if she is over 35), see a doctor together.

nudges.title: Reminders on this phone
nudges.body: A nudge before her period, on day one, and on tougher days.
nudges.period_soon_body: Stock up on her favourite snacks and plan a calm evening.
nudges.period_start_body: A warm drink, chocolate or flowers would be lovely today.
nudges.check_in_body: Ask how she's feeling and take a chore off her plate.
nudges.pms_body: Be extra patient. A kind message goes a long way.
nudges.fertile_body: The next few days are the best chance to conceive. Keep it relaxed.
nudges.best_day_body: Today and tomorrow are the most likely days. No pressure, just time together.

menstrual.0: Bring her a hot water bottle or heating pad.
menstrual.1: Surprise her with her favourite chocolate.
menstrual.2: Make her a warm ginger or mint tea.
menstrual.3: Take over dinner or the dishes tonight.

follicular.0: Plan a walk or a small outing together.
follicular.1: Ask about her plans and cheer her on.
follicular.2: Cook a fresh, colourful meal together.
follicular.3: Book something fun for the weekend.

ovulation.0: Tell her something you love about her.
ovulation.3: Take a photo together and send it to her.

luteal.0: Be extra patient. Short tempers aren't about you.
luteal.1: Bring her a comfort snack she loves.
luteal.2: Offer a gentle shoulder or back massage.
luteal.3: Give her quiet time without asking why.

pregnancy.0: Rub her feet or back tonight.
pregnancy.1: Take on an extra chore so she can rest.
pregnancy.2: Go to the next check-up with her.
pregnancy.3: Ask what she's worried about, and just listen.

menstrual.0: Thinking of you today. Rest up, I've got dinner covered ❤️
menstrual.1: Sending you a big hug. Need anything on my way home?

follicular.0: You've got this today. So proud of you 🌸
follicular.1: Free this weekend? I'd love to take you out.

ovulation.0: Just a reminder that you're amazing 💕
ovulation.1: Can't stop thinking about you today.

luteal.0: However you feel today is okay. I'm here for you 🤍
luteal.1: You don't have to do it all. Let me help tonight.

pregnancy.0: You and our little one mean everything to me 💛
pregnancy.1: You're doing an incredible job. Rest, I'll handle things.
